sources.quote: SUP-C,Meccanica Chisone S.r.l.,aluminium extrusions and blanks

findings.why: No controlled approval record covers HS-410 at Meccanica Chisone for any receiving plant or customer. The only HS-410 customer reference in the documents is the DEV-121 agreement with Aurelia. The supplier's listed commodity is aluminium extrusions and blanks, not stamping. The 2026-11-06 review set the supplier back to approved but said part approvals stay as they are. Absence of a record is not proof of non-approval, so a person must confirm whether a part, plant and customer release exists.
